item.title: 【Helpdesk】Set correct colors for ProRes masters in VLC
item.description:
Hello everyone,
I noticed that the colors of my ProRes masters are never rendered correctly when playing them in VLC. The contrast is always far too high, causing details in bright areas to be lost due to overexposure, while details in dark areas are lost as well:


So I did some research and found a solution: Tools > Preferences > Video > Output > Direct3D9 video output
The colors should now be displayed correctly:


I don't know why, but changing this setting also caused my DVD-ISOs to stop working properly. Luckily, I also found a solution for that: Tools > Preferences > Input / Codecs > Hardware-accelerated decoding > Disable
With both settings changed, ProRes masters are displayed with the correct colors, and DVD-ISOs work properly again.
item.author: Hard Hardy
